prototypeScope: V1.17 single print-now package: all of V1.16 plus three head parts for the Radxa Cubie A7Z and the Radxa Camera 13M 214 (Shawn 2026-10-15), on top of the printed V1.8 set and the V1.9 Orange plate. Orange plate: the layout F rear converter box frame and cap of V1.16 (four hidden M2 x 10, no front passage P1, same print poses as V1.11) plus the A7Z cap wire clip (the V1.9 cap clip with a notch over the micro HDMI). White plate: colour scheme C (Shawn, 2026-10-14), the V2.0 side shells, the two stock thighs in white (colour only), the A7Z head cap in white (the V1.9 cap with the board rails relieved to round pads at the four holes and a slot through each rail end for the camera connector and the microSD; the head stays on ROBOTIS M2.6 screws) and the A7Z face panel (four camera bosses on its back, front unchanged). The eye trim is the V1.8 trim byte for byte and is reused. The orange shells, thighs and V1.9 cap become spares; the V1.8 face and the V1.9 cap clip are retired. The V2.0 cap, lower head shell and jaw frame stay deferred until the head is next opened.
knownFitBoundary: Shells need the V1.9 rear pack (its shoulder bars); Shawn confirmed it is fitted. The pack bar has no printed pilot: drill dia 1.6 through the shell roof hole with a tape flag 7.0 mm from the tip. Driver above each pack screw on the finished robot: 57.8 mm to the lower head shell. Cap: closes with the same three ROBOTIS M2.6 x 6 as the V1.9 cap; the A7Z rests on the four round pads and screws on with the Pi screws (E-pi-01..04). Face: the camera takes 4 x M2 x 4 into 2.4 mm of thread (below the 3.5 mm target, face-a7z/README.md) and the eye trim 2 x M2 x 6 from the face back; the image needs a 90 deg rotation in software. Thighs: same geometry as the 10/1 thighs; fitting them means taking both legs apart and re-reading the joint zeros (guide/firmware/mac/pose_snapshot.py).
processOverrideReason: PLAN-V1.12.md section C (the rough crown Shawn sanded on the V1.9 cap is its outer dome printed on support interface). The cap keeps the V1.9 roof-down pose, so the crown band still prints on single-material support (the club X1C has an AMS but no support material, Shawn 2026-10-14). The White donor profiles print that interface coarser than the V1.9 Orange files: 2 interface layers at 0.5 mm spacing and 80 mm/s, bridges at 50 mm/s. These overrides carry the V1.9 Orange values (3 layers, 0.15 mm spacing, top z gap 0.2 mm, interface 40 mm/s, bridges 30 mm/s) and turn on support ironing at the donor default flow (10 %) and spacing (0.15 mm), which reprints the top interface layer smooth. Elegoo: support_ironing is set next to enable_support_ironing, and support_style default replaces the donor tree_hybrid to match the V1.9 slice the crown was measured on. First layer 0.2 mm (White donors 0.28) as on the V1.9 cap and the other colours: at 0.28 the cap brim filled 2.6 mm2 of the concave end of the crown strip in the first White slice. Brim: per object (rows.json objectSettings), not plate-wide.
